metadata.description: Manage people and shared databases on a local LastDB node.

schemas.name: Person
schemas.purpose_statement: One person the owner has added. The hash coordinate person_id is the hash of node_key.

field_descriptions.person_id: Stable id of this person: the hash of node_key.
field_descriptions.node_key: Node key of this person. person_id is its hash.
field_descriptions.contact_code: Code another person uses to add this contact.
field_descriptions.added_at: When this person was added, RFC 3339.

schemas.name: AddressBookEntry
schemas.purpose_statement: A keyed reference to a verified Social contact.

field_descriptions.person_id: Primary key of the private Social Person record.

schemas.name: SharingUpdate
schemas.purpose_statement: The last pending Social sharing update for one database.

field_descriptions.request: The exact pending revision and member configuration.

schemas.name: Circle
schemas.purpose_statement: One private reusable circle. The range coordinate is circle_id.

field_descriptions.name: Name the owner gave this circle.
field_descriptions.members: Node keys of the verified contacts in this circle.
field_descriptions.links: Write scope of this circle on each linked database.

schemas.name: DatabaseUpdate
schemas.purpose_statement: Circle update progress for one owned database. The range coordinate is database_id.

field_descriptions.pending: Whether a circle update for this database is unfinished.
field_descriptions.operation: The latest approved sharing operation on this database and its outcome.

schemas.name: CirclePolicy
schemas.purpose_statement: Social circles granting access to one named database.

field_descriptions.circles: The circle names, member identities and schema write scopes.

schemas.name: SharingRequest
schemas.purpose_statement: One app proposal and its owner-approved sharing outcome.

field_descriptions.request: The exact app declaration and its sharing outcome.

schemas.name: PendingSharingRequest
schemas.purpose_statement: One app proposal awaiting the owner's sharing decision.

field_descriptions.request_id: Stable identifier of the saved sharing request.
field_descriptions.app_id: Label of the app that proposed the sharing request.
field_descriptions.database_id: Stable identifier of the database in the proposal.

schemas.name: DatabaseSetup
schemas.purpose_statement: Progress for a database provisioned from a named Social setup.

field_descriptions.database_id: Stable ID of the database chosen for this setup.
field_descriptions.ready: Whether Social confirmed the complete schema setup.
